# URAWAKE Stackhouse

> Web development studio in Los Angeles, California. Full-stack websites, CRMs,
> and internal tools for small businesses, with a focus on tourism and hospitality.

Last updated: 2026-08-29

## What is URAWAKE Stackhouse?
URAWAKE Stackhouse is a web development studio founded by Daniel Sangronis, based in Los Angeles, California. We design and build full-stack web applications, CRMs, and digital tools for small businesses and startups across the United States.

## What does URAWAKE Stackhouse build?
Full-stack web applications, booking systems, internal CRM platforms, marketing websites, and API integrations. We come in at the brand level (identity, design, and development) and deliver a complete, live product.

## Who is the right client for URAWAKE?
Small businesses and startups that need more than a template. Our main clientele is in tourism and hospitality, but we work across industries. We're the right fit if you need a partner who can think at the brand level and actually build it.

## Where does URAWAKE Stackhouse operate?
We serve clients across the United States. Most current clients are based in Puerto Rico and California.

## What does a typical project involve?
Every project starts with brand and product strategy, then moves into design and development. We build everything to production. No handoffs, no half-finished work.

## Who works at URAWAKE Stackhouse?
Two people. Daniel Sangronis is a web developer and creative director based in Los Angeles who owns the code. Janyerlyn Morales owns the visual identity and brand design. Both work the same project at the same time, which is why the build matches the design.
GitHub: https://github.com/danielsangronis1386 | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/daniel-sangronis-65210117a/

## Services
- Full-stack development (React, Node.js, Django, PostgreSQL)
- API integration (Stripe, Gmail API, REST, Webhooks)
- CRM and internal business tools (leads, bookings, campaigns, automation)
- UI/UX build (Figma to code, responsive, motion-enhanced)
- Deployment and CI/CD (Vercel, Heroku, Netlify)

## Case Studies

### Eliot's Adventures — tour booking website and CRM
https://urawake.dev/case-studies/eliots-adventures
Full website and custom booking system for a family-run Puerto Rico tour and taxi service that had no online presence. Built in 4 months (February to June 2026). Results: 100+ bookings and 100+ unique customers in the first four months, roughly 20 hours per month of manual work automated, 130+ waivers digitized, across 389 commits.
Stack: React, Vite, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Stripe, Gmail API, Heroku, PDFKit
Live: https://www.eliotsadventures.com/

### Eliot's Adventures CRM — internal operations platform
https://urawake.dev/case-studies/eliots-crm
The operations engine behind the booking system: Gmail parsing, automated booking creation, a waiver dashboard, and full customer history in one platform. Built alongside the public site, February to June 2026.
Stack: React, Vite, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Gmail API, Heroku

### ToursToDo PR — tour operator website
https://urawake.dev/case-studies/tourstodo-website
A React storefront replacing a WordPress site, built around how travellers actually pick a tour: tour catalog with filters, island guide content, FAQ, and a Stripe booking flow. Built May to July 2026, launched at tourstodopr.com in October 2026.
Stack: React, Vite, React Router v7, CSS Modules, Stripe, Vercel
Live: https://tourstodopr.com/

### ToursToDo CRM — custom CRM and email automation
https://urawake.dev/case-studies/tourstodopr
From zero infrastructure and manual Gmail replies to a fully custom CRM with automated flows, a campaign engine, and an affiliate portal. Manages leads, bookings, customer segments, and affiliate tracking with AI-assisted lead qualification. In production.
Stack: React, Vite, Recharts, Node.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Stripe, SendGrid, Heroku
